_schema.description: Optional dated annotations displayed independently of player performance. Keys are player display names. Events record documented public statements or appearances; they do not infer private beliefs or claim causation with performance.

Baker Mayfield.title: Mayfield later identifies 2020 PAO involvement as important in his Christian faith
Baker Mayfield.note: In a later Sports Spectrum interview, Mayfield said that joining Professional Athletes Outreach with his wife in February 2020 was an important point in the strengthening of his Christian faith. The date is month-level and uses the first day as a plotting anchor.

C.J. Stroud.title: Stroud discusses finding Christ for himself in college
C.J. Stroud.note: In a pre-draft interview discussed by Faith on the Field, Stroud described growing up in church, falling away as a child, and coming to know Christ for himself in college.

C.J. Stroud.title: Stroud publicly credits prayer and God's grace after Cincinnati win
C.J. Stroud.note: After Houston's win at Cincinnati, Stroud discussed prayer, God's grace and mercy, and said his platform is about God's glory rather than himself.

TreVeyon Henderson.title: Henderson participates in Ohio State campus faith event
TreVeyon Henderson.note: Henderson was among Ohio State players speaking at a large campus Christian gathering where more than 50 students were baptized. The source identifies the event as occurring in August; the first day is used as a plotting anchor.

TreVeyon Henderson.title: Henderson discusses his testimony and identity in Jesus
TreVeyon Henderson.note: Sports Spectrum published a podcast episode in which Henderson discussed his Ohio State transformation, sharing his faith as an NFL player, his testimony, and identity in Jesus.

TreVeyon Henderson.title: Henderson says he will continue publicly sharing his Christian faith
TreVeyon Henderson.note: Speaking to reporters, Henderson discussed criticism of his religious posts and said he intended to continue sharing his faith in Jesus.
